# SPLectrum

A framework at the intersection of philosophy of language, systems theory,
and software engineering. Three fabrics: Mycelium (data), SPLectrum
(language), HAICC (cognition).

Data repositories with embedded functionality: git repos that carry their
own code, schemas, and references as colocated metadata.

**[splectrum.world](https://splectrum.world)**: philosophy, engineering, and the seed principles.

## Where to start

To run something: **[haiccing](https://github.com/haiccing)**, projects you
can run, each with the packages it needs; its profile says how.

## The organisations

| Organisation | Holds |
|---|---|
| [haiccing](https://github.com/haiccing) | projects and packages, ready to run: the place to start |
| [splectral](https://github.com/splectral) | Splectral components: views and scenarios for the browser platform |
| [pear-full-square](https://github.com/pear-full-square) | the code: mycelium, the p2p substrate, Splectral, HAICC, the package manager, as modules |
| [bare-for-pear](https://github.com/bare-for-pear) | infrastructure modules for the Bare runtime |
| splectrum (here) | the language, and the development environments the rest is built in |

## Here

- [dev-env-2-p2p-cluster](https://github.com/splectrum/dev-env-2-p2p-cluster): the
  current development environment, a P2P cluster: every module is built,
  tested and published from it.
- [roadmap-1](https://github.com/splectrum/roadmap-1),
  [the-world-of-splectrum](https://github.com/splectrum/the-world-of-splectrum).
- Earlier work, archived: `dev-env-1-mycelium-git`, `spl0` to `spl8`, and
  others.
